entry.title: Changelog: tramaj
entry.content:
Changelog: tramaj

Release history of tramaj, the reference PureScript implementation: parser, evaluator, Node codec and analyses. Releases happen when there are major changes rather than on a schedule; each entry below is one version. Every implementation has its own page like this one, and each page is tagged so the site builds one Atom feed per implementation: #changelog #purescript #tramaj

tramaj (none)unreleased

Consumed as a git dependency; no registry release yet.

  • added Reference implementation of the language: parser, evaluator (concrete and symbolic modes), normative Node JSON codec and static analyses.
  • added Conformance corpus under `corpus/cases`, shared with every other implementation.
entry.summary: Release history of `tramaj`, the reference PureScript implementation: parser, evaluator, Node codec and analyses.
